meta.siteDescription: Portfolio of Ken — HSEQ & Training Officer specializing in safety trainings, eLearning development, and HSSEQ programs.

about.bio: I am an HSEQ & Training Officer specializing in occupational safety, compliance, and innovative training solutions. With expertise in blended learning, eLearning systems, and regulatory compliance, I help organizations strengthen safety culture while ensuring training excellence.
focus: Designing 8–40 hr safety courses and manuals
Converting trainings to interactive eLearning with AI-friendly narration
HSSEQ monthly campaigns and program implementation

roles.title: Lead, Training Division
roles.summary: Promoted to lead Petrosphere’s Training Division, managing a three-person team and taking full responsibility for training operations, schedules, materials, trainer assignments, client proposals, revenue targets, service quality, and client satisfaction.

achievements.label: Division Leadership
achievements.description: Led a three-person training team and assumed full accountability for the division’s operations, performance, quality, and client experience.

achievements.label: Approval & Governance
achievements.description: Approved training schedules, learning materials, trainer assignments, and proposals submitted to prospective clients.

achievements.label: Commercial Accountability
achievements.description: Took responsibility for training targets, revenue performance, proposal quality, and client satisfaction.

achievements.label: Decision-Making Authority
achievements.description: Gained expanded authority to make operational and commercial training decisions that previously required supervisory approval.

achievements.label: Delegation & Delivery
achievements.description: Continued to personally manage selected training batches while assigning and overseeing delivery responsibilities across the team.

achievements.label: Hands-On Leadership
achievements.description: Maintained direct involvement in training operations while establishing clearer accountability, delegation, and quality oversight across the division.

roles.title: HSSEQ & Training Officer
roles.summary: Managed end-to-end occupational safety training operations while supporting HSSEQ compliance, instructional design, learning systems, client coordination, and process improvement.

achievements.label: Training Operations
achievements.description: Managed the full lifecycle of occupational safety and professional training programs, including participant registration, trainer scheduling, session preparation, facilitation support, attendance monitoring, post-training documentation, and trainer payment coordination.

achievements.label: Instructional Design & Facilitation
achievements.description: Designed and delivered accredited and technical training experiences, including the 40-hour Advanced Food Safety Training, 20-hour Intravenous Therapy Training, and digital learning content for BOSH, COSH, HIRAC, SPA, Electrical Safety, and Lockout-Tagout.

achievements.label: Learning Systems & Digital Platforms
achievements.description: Administered and improved the company’s WordPress-based LMS, main website, training management system, student records, and certificate verification workflows to create a smoother learner and client experience.

achievements.label: Process Improvement & Automation
achievements.description: Built automated Excel trackers, dashboards, templates, certificate workflows, and standardized procedures that reduced repetitive administrative work and improved coordination across training, sales, marketing, accounting, and compliance activities.

achievements.label: Compliance & Governance
achievements.description: Prepared and submitted DOLE training notifications and post-training reports, supported WARMA compliance reporting, maintained organizational risk records, and helped complete the company’s Data Protection Officer registration with the National Privacy Commission.

achievements.label: Leadership & Representation
achievements.description: Facilitated 75+ training sessions for approximately 1,900 participants, hosted webinars with 1,000+ attendees, served as emcee for the 6th OSH & Environment National Convention, and represented the organization in meetings, inductions, and public safety engagements.

roles.title: QA/QC Intern
roles.summary: Supported inspection and quality-control activities for wellhead components, drill strings, valves, and structural materials using precision measurement tools, while documenting findings for compliance and purchasing workflows.

achievements.description: Conducted dimensional inspections using calipers, micrometers, and vernier scales.
Supported QA/QC reports, purchase-order documentation, and equipment verification.
Followed industrial safety and quality procedures in an oil-and-gas service environment.

engagements.description: Delivered accredited training programs across synchronous, face-to-face, and eLearning formats.
